fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with the COO and Sales Operations Manager. Acme tracks customers and deals in spreadsheets, Outlook and a shared drive, and missed two contract renewals last quarter. They want one place for accounts, deals and renewals, with a reliable pipeline view. About 60 users, mobile access and Outlook sync are needed, plus integration with the TMS and ERP. Budget is USD 80k-100k per year and go-live is needed by March 2027. A technical scoping workshop with Rui Tavares was agreed for the week of 9 Nov.
